verdict.rationale: Angular's first-party docs explicitly describe a fully featured platform where 'everything works together' with first-party modules for forms, which covers the core of the story: official forms tooling integrated with the framework. The evidence is only a single marketing-level line, though, with no detail on how forms are built or validated. Missing for 10: documentation of form validation capabilities, details of the forms APIs and how they integrate with signals or DI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
